hṛtpadme nābhipadme ca mukhapadme tathaiva ca
navadvārāṇi saṅghaṭṭa navanāḍīrnirodhayet
tasya padmasya vai nālaṃ piṅgalānāḍirucyate
pradhānānāḍayastrisrastālabdhvā vedayet puram
tasyā madhye sthitaṃ jñeyaṃ sarvakāraṇamavyayam
daśamadvāramāśritya daśamānāḍikā *? ha
ākāśaṃ grāhayet tasya granthi bhedaiḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ
pare sthāne layaṃ kṛtvā niṣkampaḥ susamāhitaḥ
praṇavaṃ tu samuccārya tālvoṣṭhapuṭaśobhitam
karaṇānyapraśeṣāṇi granthi dvārāṇi sarvaśaḥ
yāvacca jñāyate vatsa tāvad brahmalayī bhavet
taṃ viditvā mahāsena utkrānti kartu marhasi
etat sarvaṃ samācakṣva yadi tuṣṭosi me prabho
anyathā naiva siddhyanti kalpakoṭi śatairapi
etan me saṃśayaṃ sarvaṃ vaktumarhasya śeṣataḥ
yattvayā veditaṃ praśnaṃ tat sarvaṃ kathayāmite
śaśi madhye sthitaṃ tejastejomadhye sthitaṃ param
* *? koṭi? pratīkāśaṃ duṣprekṣaṃ layavarjitam
teṣāṃ madhye paraṃ tejo ye nedaṃ pratitiṣṭhitam
brahmadvārasya vai pṛṣṭhe dhūmroyaṃ sarvataḥ sthitaḥ
anyathā naiva siddhyanti yuktihīnāḥ śikhidhvaja
sā śaktiḥ sa śivaṃ jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ cākṣaramavyayam
sa muktaḥ sarvaduḥkhebhyaḥ sadyo brahmaṇi kalpayan
sa vai līno pare vatsa ityājñā pārameśvarī
brahmaṇaṃ tu samantavyaṃ brahmākṣara la * * *?
kālāgni rudraparyantaṃ yāvadbrahmāṇḍagocaram
vāṅmayaṃ sakalaṃ yaśca trailokyaṃ sa carācaram
tasmin neva layaṃ kuryāt te caiva brahmavādinaḥ
tryakṣaraṃ ca tridhā bhinnaṃ tristhānaṃ triguṇātmakam
pañcamūrti dharaṃ devaṃ śivaṃ paramakāraṇam
devadānava * ? ddhānāṃ gandharvoragarakṣasām
p. 4a) brahmāviṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraḥ śiva eva ca
akṣaraṃ cakṣaraṃ caiva sa nāmaṃ nāmavarjitam
uccāryaṃ tu hyanuccāryaṃ svaramasvarameva ca
sa mantraṃ ca hyamantraṃ ca grāhyamagrāhyameva ca
praṇavaṃ yo na jānāti viśvasyā yatanaṃ param
viśeṣataḥ punarvatsa triṣu sthāneṣu saṃsthitaḥ
sa pratyakṣaṃ dṛśyate vai vikārāvasthitaḥ prabhuḥ
bhuñjate jighrate caiva śṛṇu vakṣyāmi hetutaḥ
sukhaduḥkhānyasau vetti śītoṣṇasparśanāni ca
ete pratyakṣato yasya dṛśyante vai ṣaḍānana
nānyadīpaṃ svarūpeṇa paramātmā ca labhyate
tristhānāvasthitaṃ devaṃ śrotumicchāmi vai prabho
tristhānāvasthitaṃ brahma tacchṛṇuṣva yathākramam
mukhapadme nābhipadme gatāgatiṃ karoti saḥ
praṇādyā vāyavaḥ sarve vahante teṣu nāḍiṣu
pradhānā piṅgalā śūnya sṛjate pahare tu saḥ
p. 5b) nāḍi cakrasya vai tad vat piṅgalā madhyatodbhavā
ekakāyaṃ ca sarvāsāṃ yukti bhede pṛthak pṛthak
suṣupiṅgalā dakṣiṇaputra tratra sūryo vyavasthitaḥ
iḍāmadhye sthitaṃ deva pitṛyāneti kathyate
suṣumṇā madhyamānāḍī tatrasthaṃ mokṣamārgadaśa
karṇikānta sthitaṃ devamavyaktaṃ rūpavarjitam
p. 6a) tāsāṃ madhye tu vai hyekā suṣumṇā nāma śrūyate
tasyābhyantarasaṃlīnau prāṇāpānau vyavasthitau
sṛṣṭipralayarūpeṇa sthitā vetau kumāraka
ādhārādheya bhāvena parāpara vibhāgaśaḥ
tayormadhye sthitaṃ brahma anyaktaṃ rūpavarjitam
nābhipadmasya vai pṛṣṭe hṛtpadmaṃ tu adho mukham
ubhābhyāṃ karṇikā madhye paraṃ tadvīkṣya putraka
yaṃ dṛṣṭvāhaṃ gamiṣyāmi ajanma padamavyayam
yat tvayā coditaṃ praśnaṃ durvijñeyaṃ surorapi
na tu devyā tvayā caiva yadabhya paripṛcchitam
vikṣepa vacanaṃ rakṣeccharaṇāgatavatsvata
adīkṣitena dātavyamaśraddheyamanārjavo
dātavyaṃ dīkṣate putra gurudevāgnipūjake
parīkṣyate guruḥ śiṣyamabdāni dvādaśāni vai
anena bhāvitaṃ viśvaṃ sarvameva carācaram
adyame saphalā buddhiradyame saphalaṃ tapaḥ
muktosmi cā?dya vai tāta bhavasaṃsārabandhanāt
tat tohaṃ kathayiṣyāmi prāṇāpānau yathā sthitau
teṣāṃ madhye pradhānau dvau prāṇāpānau prakīrtitau
yogamārgeṣu sarveṣu gatireṣā pravartate
hṛtpadme nābhipadme tu dvādaśānte tathaiva ca
apānaḥ saṃharet prāṇaṃ prāṇopānasya vai tathā
udayāsta manaṃ hyetan nānyaṃ manye śikhidhvaja
tapate satataṃ vatsa viśvaṃ diṅmārgavīkṣaṇe
yaṃ jñātvā prāpyate mokṣo yena bhūyo na jāyate
ahorātraṃ kṛtaṃ caiva saṅkrānti viṣvavad dvayam
yat tvayā coditaṃ praśnamanākhyaṃ kathayāmite
tasya śaktirbhavedeṣā udayāsta manaṃ prati
p. 8b) aliṅgaṃ liṅgarūpeṇa avyaktaṃ vyaktagocaram
pṛthivyāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśa eva ca
ākāśaṃ grasate śaktiryathāgrastākhilaṃ jagat
pralayaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ mayā te kathitaṃ suta
p. 20a) * * * * * * * * ākāraṃ brahmasaṃsthitam
tat sarvaṃ kathayiṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvā vahitaṃ tathā
śūnyācchūnyataraṃ śūnyaṃ tacchūnyaṃ śūnyameva ca
śūnyasyā śūnyatāṃ brūhi yadi tuṣṭosi me prabho
aśūnyaṃ taṃ vijānīyāt sarvaśūnyā layaṃ hitam
na tu jānanti taṃ śūnyamaśūnyā yena te kṛtāḥ
p. 20b) aśūnyaṃ teṣvamīrūpaṃ sarvagaṃ cetanātmakam
vijñānaṃ jñāpakaṃ śūnyaṃ nirālambābalambhitam
taṃ śūnyaṃ śūnyamityāhurvadanti jñānabuddhayaḥ
sṛṣṭipralaya rohitvā cchūnyasyāśūnyatāṃ viduḥ
tasmādaśūnyatā śūnye nirālambhāvalambhinam
vijñānajñānayogena śūnyaṃ jñeyaṃ labheṣyasi
p. 21a) teṣāṃ śūnyamidaṃ śūnyamajñānā yeṣu bhāvanā
brahmādi stambhaparyantaṃ sarvaṃ śūnyena pūritam
yathā caitanya bhāvena bodhitaṃ bhuvana trayam
taṃ śūnyaṃ jñāna rūpeṇa jñeyaṃ śūnyaṃ na tadguha
na punaḥ śūnya bhāvastu śūnyesmiṃstattvataḥ suta
naṣṭa sūryendu vātaughairgrahanakṣatra tārakaiḥ
na cordhvaṃ naiva pātālaṃ mahābhūtaistu varjitam
tasmin kāle tayā śaktyā cidrūpāyā śivotthitā
bhūtasṛṣṭi hitārthāya plāvitaṃ cākhilaṃ jagat
kalpāntaṃ yāvadaṇḍaṃ tadaṇu rūpeṇasaṃsthitam
aṣṭā śā vidiśaścāṣṭau madhye bījāṅkuraṃ padam
tasyāṅkurasya pṛṣṭhe tu mahāpadmaṃ sitaṃ śubham
praṇavaṃ taṃ ca vijñeyaṃ padmaṃ padmadale kṣaṇam
karṇikānte sthitaṃ vatsa sarvalokapitāmaham
tadā prajāpatirvatsa viśvakartā maheśvaraḥ
sūryakoṭi pratīkāśaṃ kalpāntāgni samaprabham
vyaktībhūtaṃ tadāvatsa diśoṣṭau gaganaṃ kṣitiḥ
dalāṣṭakaṃ diśaścāṣṭau brahmapadmasya ṣaṇmukha
sarvaṃ praṇavasaṃbhūtaṃ cicchaktyā cetanodbhavam
tacca padmasthitaṃ vatsa amṛtodadhimadhyagam
tadā tasyoditā buddhiryogamabhyamanaṃ prati
tasya yoga phalāvāptiścicchaktyā praṇave hṛtam
brahmādi stambha paryantaṃ yāvat kālādi gocaram
sarvaṃ ca khalvidaṃ brahmasvatorthaṃ brahma vādinam
sarveṣāṃ caiva bhūtānāṃ praṇavaṃ yoniśakti dhṛt
p. 23a) praṇavena bhavet padmaṃ cicchaktyaṅkurasannibham
praṇavaṃ yona jānāti bindunādendu bhūṣitam
arddhamātrāsamudbhutaṃ praṇavaṃ sarvadā guha
tasminneva layaṃ kuryāt tenaivaṃ brahmavādinaḥ
tairjñātamamṛtaṃ teṣāmajñānaṃ ca viṣaṃ bhavet
tasyāpi lakṣaso hyaṃśo yojānāti sa brahmavit
adhunā śrotumicchāmi strīpuṃsoścaiva sambhavam
tattehaṃ kathaṃyiṣyāmi rahasyaṃ praśnapūrvakam
tapaśca sumahattīrṇāṃ duṣkaraṃ cādbhutopamam
paraṃ brahmaśivaṃ jñeyaṃ paraṃ sthānamanāmayam
tena tuṣṭena devena cicchaktyā cetanā guha
p. 24a) ārādhito hyahaṃ tena bhaktyāparamayāyadā
tadādi dṛṣṭa pūrvoyamevaṃ padma tanurbhavet
sa tu viṣṇurvijānīyā cchaktirūpeṇa śakti dhṛt
ubhābhyāṃ bījarūpeṇa padmayonistṛtīyakaḥ
praṇavaṃ tu bhavedeṣa a u-makṣarayojitam
caturviṃśati tatvāni puruṣaṃ pañcaviṃśakam
anye ye kecicchārīrā vyaktā-avyakta vāyavaḥ
taṃ rasaṃ brahmamityāhurānandakaraṇaṃ param
sṛṣṭirūpeṇamartyānāmamaratve vyavasthitaḥ
caturdaśavidhivatsa bhūtasargaṃ carācaram
brahmatejassamutpannāvagnīṣomau śikhidhvaja
evaṃ sarve samārambhāḥ sarvabījeṣu saṃsthitāḥ
yathānyagrodha bījānāṃ nyagrodhābhyantare sthitaḥ
yat tvayā coditaṃ praśnaṃ tat sarvaṃ śṛṇu ṣaṇmukha
samutpadyanti saṃsāre yoni lakṣvāntareṣu ca
evaṃ kartā ca karmabhyo bhuñjate vai śubhā śubham
p. 26b) ubhābhyāṃ tatra saṃyogādbhagaliṅgasamāgame
yonidvārasya vai pṛṣṭhe nābhipadmaṃ sthitaṃ guha
rajaḥ pravartate hyasyāṃ divasāni tu ṣoḍaśa
tasmin bījaṃ yadā kṣiptamṛtukāle śikhidhvaja
puṃset karṣa bhavet puṃsaḥ striyotkarṣe bhavet striyaḥ
yugme yugānu yugme strī antakālena puṃsakam
p. 26a) tasya madhye sthitā vatsa piṅgalādaspṛtodbhavā
jāyate puruṣaścaivamānandayati sarvadā
purapraveśametaddhi amaratvaṃ ca vai bhavet
jantavo gotra santānā amaratvaṃ tadā bhavet
vasate satataṃ vatsa divasāni tu ṣoḍaśaḥ
tasya padmasya garbhoyaṃ garbhaśayyā śikhidhvaja
tasya madhye yadā kṣiptaṃ kṣiptaṃ bījevakalpayet
duṣkṛtīnāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ garbhavāsaḥ prakīrtitaḥ
sarvaṃ cicchaktinā vyāptaṃ śivājñā coditaṃ guha
prarohaṃ kuru vṛddhiṃ ca anyathā tasya codanam
tasya bījaṃ kurutyantā tayā sṛṣṭaṃ carācaram
yosau yoniḥ sanidhanaṃ paramārthaṃ tu taṃ viduḥ
śaktirna lupyate cāsya śivayogā śikhidhvaja
agnīṣomānilayutaṃ viśate parameśvaraḥ
astaṅgataistairnidhanaṃ dehe deheśvaro guha
tatoṅkuraṃ ca padmaṃ ca tatva brahmādanantaram
gāyatrī tu bhavet taistu mahādevāti nissṛtam
cicchakti saṃbhavaṃ sarvaṃ brahmāṇḍa kuharodaram
mayā sṛṣṭaṃ jagatsarvaṃ bhūtasargaṃ carācaram
cicchaktyā cetanodbhūtaṃ dvitīye māsi budbudam
cicchakti sambhavā hyata sarveṣāmantare sthitāḥ
vyaktirna dṛśyate tasya avyakta tvāt sṛjatyasau
carāṇā?macarāṇāṃ ca bhūtānāṃ śikhivāhana
taṃ nālaṃ padmagarbhasya nābhinālaṃ prakīrtitam
yathā bījāṅkuraṃ vatsa avyaktaṃ naiva dṛśyate
tadā vyaktaṃ bhavet kāyaṃ puruṣā kṛti saṃjñakam
majjāsthi snāyumedhaṃ ca māṃsaṃ rudirameva ca
sirānāḍī granthayaśca dvārāḥ kūrmāśca jālakāḥ
ete cānyepi ye keciccharīrotpatti kāraṇam
pañcame māsi samaye na khalomāni spandanam
vyaktatvaṃ sarvamaṅgānāṃ yathā yasya tu kalpitam
ṣaṣṭhe māsi rasān sarvān yadā te mātṛ bhojanāt
cicchakti cetanorthe na cetanāṃ cetate tu yaḥ
yadā prabudhyate cāgnirhyadisthaṃ tacca vai guha
padmatrayaṃ prabuddhyeta hyannābhi mukhasaṃsthitam
liṅgadyānāḍayaḥ sarvā hṛtpadmadalasambhavāḥ
tairvyāptamakhilaṃ piṇḍaṃ lomāntaṃ yāvat ṣaṇmukha
yathā sūryodaye sarvaṃ rasmibhirvyāpitaṃ jagat
cicchakti cetanorthāṃya bahiḥ sūryaṃ śikhidhvaja
aṣṭamena tu māsena buddhirgarbhasya saṃbhavet
tamondhakāragahane sarvaduḥkhasamākule
kaliśseṣmasaṅkīrṇe māṃsāsthisnāyu saṅkaṭe
teṣāṃ madhyānmahāghoraṃ narakaṃ kukṣi sambhavam
narakārṇavasaṃprakhyaṃ duḥkhakalloladussaham
evaṃ sañcintyamānasya cicchaktyā coditasya ca
ata ūrddhvaṃ tu ye kecit garbhavāse vasanti ca
darśanaṃ daśame māsi sukṛtāni tu cintayet
tadahaṃ tat kariṣyāmi yena bhuyo na jāyate
vedeṣu sarvaśāstreṣu purāṇeṣu smṛtīṣu ca
evaṃ sañcintya mānasya cicchaktyā prasavaṃ kṛtam
atyanta bhayabhītā tu maṇḍa udbijitā guha
vidārya padmaṃ garbhasya yonidvāra mukhe gatam
p. 30b) vidārya sṛṣṭiṃ dvāreṇa mātuḥ sandeha kārakam
na tasya sukṛte buddhirna ca duṣkṛta karmaṇi
utpattireṣābhūtānāṃ yonijānāṃ śikhidhvaja
tatrāpi saṃśayaṃ deva vartate dhātu saṅkṣayāt
p. 31a) yat tvayā coditaṃ praśnaṃ putrasnehādvadāmite
yathā vai dhātu saṃkhyānamaṅgānāṃ ca śṛṇuṣvame
rasaṃ sambhavate vatsa māsamekaṃ tu niṣphalā
parāgni saṃbhavaṃ taṃ vai na sa śukro bhavatyasau
rasādraktaṃ tato māṃsaṃ māṃsānmedotha jāyate
śukrāddhātūni sarvāṇi dhātubhyāṃ dehamānuṣam
evaṃ hi prathamaṃ tāvaccharīrotpatti kāraṇam
vātaṃ pittaṃ tathā śleṣmaṃ dhātavaḥ parikīrtitāḥ
śarīradhāraṇā hyete saṅkhyāsaṅkhyā kṛtāṃ guṇāḥ
tāsāṃ saṅkhyā bhavedeṣā kalpanā śikhivāhana
vāyu bhāve guṇā ye ca ye vāne yau dhvane tathā
atorthā dhātu pūrvāye asaṅkhyeyāvilāguha
tena santarpite naiva dhātavastarpitā guha
p. 32a) sa tu gandha guṇasparśaṃ bhuñjate dehasaṃsthitaḥ
tasmād vai sarvadā vatsa sa kartāsevakāraṇam
tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni te jāyattāni sarvaśaḥ
sa tu māṃsaṃ samāśritya saṃsthitaṃ sarvadehinām
p. 32b) māṃsaṃ peśīśatānyaṣṭau śataiketaiva cādhikaḥ
pittasya tu palānyaṣṭau śleṣmarakta samāśritam
vasāmedaḥ pṛthaktvena ubhau viṃśatpalīnakau
vasādāhārapānāṃbhyāṃ viṇmūtraṃ jāyate punaḥ
raktaṃ pittaṃ tathā śleṣmaṃ śukraṃ majjā tu ṣaṇmukha
sarveṣāmeva dhātūnāṃ pittaṃ vai śleṣma bandhanam
yasmādrasodbhavāḥ sarve tadā teṣāṃ nibandhanam
asthīnāṃ tu śatāṃ trīṇi ṣaṣṭhya sthiradhikāni ca
aṣṭottaraṃ carmaśataṃ sirāṇāṃ sapta vai śatam
granthīnāṃ tu śataṃ vatsa aṣṭātriṃśottaraṃ tathā
snāyu jālamasaṃkhyeyaṃ yairbaddhaṃ kāyapañjaram
catuṣṣaṣṭirbhavet kūrcaṃ tayoḥ snāyūṃśca sambhavet
tadā yantra mayaṃ sarvaṃ śarīraṃ mānuṣātmakam
tāstu vāyu vahāḥ sarvāssarvāstā mokṣadāḥ śubhāḥ
tadudbhavāṇi sarvāṇi yathā prāṇodbhavānilāḥ
tisraḥ koṭyo va koṭistu romasaṅkhyaḥ prakīrtitāḥ
te saṅkhye yā asaṅkhye yā ye tu dehāntare sthitā
lomakrāmāni sarvāṇi dvārāṇi śikhivāhana
p. 34a) nakhānāṃ viṃśatiḥ proktā navadvārāṇi ṣaṇmukha
evaṃ saṅkhyā samudbhūtā śarīreṣu śarīriṇām
bhūyo vijñātu micchāmi brahmaveśma śarīrajām
yasmādbrahma mayaṃ dehamatrabrahma tu labhyate
yadyekona bhavet teṣāṃ tadā sarve hyapārthakāḥ
p. 34b) ekaikaṃ ca tathā bhūtamutpannaṃ śakti coditam
tasmād yantra mayaṃ sarvaṃ śarīraṃ mānuṣātmakam
māṃsarakta mṛdādigdhaṃ snāyu kīlaka kīlitam
ekona dhāryate stambhaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ yena dhāryate
brahmaṇo veśmano madhye vedamagni trayasya ca
ājyendha na tilairdarbhairdhūmairgandhaiḥ srajaiḥ śubhaiḥ
tuṣyante tarpitāvatsa prāṇāpānāhutīṣu ca
juhuyāt satataṃ vatsa prāṇāpānāvamṛtodbhavau
sravate satataṃ vatsa prāṇāgnau tarpaṇaṃ prati
bāhyāgnītamupāsīta vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā
brahmavedirbhavedeṣā brahmaveśmasya madhyataḥ
siddhānte kula siddhānte avācyaṃ yat kathaṃ ca te
p. 36a) yat tvayā coditaṃ vatsa ati snehādbadāmite
tasya madhye paraṃ tejo yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati
asaṅkhyā bhāsurābhāsaṃ brahmaveśmasya dīpanam
nadate satataṃ yasmāt tasmān nādamihocyate
abyucchinnaṃ ca taṃ nādaṃ nadate sarva dehinām
anacchaṃ kecidicchanti śūnyaṃ kecitva danti ca
p. 36b) taṃ nādaṃ prakaṭaṃ yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ mokṣo dhruvaṃ guha
tvāṃ viditvā mahāsenaṃ taṃ mokṣaṃ prāpsyase dhurvam
paramāgni samudbhūtaṃ taṃ nādaṃ nadate guha
daiśikastu sa vijñeyo mokṣo vai mokṣikastu saḥ
yena vijñāta mātreṇa bhrānti jñānaṃ nivartate
yathā vātāhate vṛkṣe śabdoyaṃ śrūyate guha
śṛṅgadhvani ninādena nadantaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti vai
na kiñcidapi taṃ vatsa yasya taṃ na hyadi sthitam
prakaṭaṃ jñāna cakṣurbhyāṃ paśyate śṛṇute tu saḥ
etena śrūyate nādaṃ na dantaṃ brahmasaṃbhavam
brahmādi stambha paryantamākārā ye bhavanti vai
gurūpadeśagamyoyaṃ yadi tuṣṭo vadatyasau
sa tṛptaḥ sa ca vai muktaḥ somṛtaṃ cāśnute dhruvam
paraṃparagataṃ vatsa parātparataraṃ hitam
brahmādi sarva bhūteṣu careṣu hyacareṣu ca
vyāpāreṣu sa vai kartā samastavyastakeṣu ca
sarve ye kecid vyāpārāḥ sṛṣṭirādyāḥ kṣayāntikāḥ
caturviṃśati tattvāni puruṣaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ
na punastāta kauleyaṃ khecarīṇāṃ mukhesthitam
yat tvayā coditaṃ praśnaṃ kaulaṃ khecari gocaram
taṃ hi siddhyanti tāsāṃ vai tāstasmiṃstejasā guha
kuvikalpagatānāṃ vai satyaṃ vatsa na siddhyati
pibanti rūpikāstaṃ tu nāḍimāśritya madhyamām
devān pitṛstarpayanti kulanāḍyāṃsta saṃsthitāḥ
na punarhomahavanairyajñaiśca bahudakṣiṇaiḥ
vivarte hyamṛtaṃ vatsa hṛdisthaṃ yatparaṃ padam
bhairavastarpitaṃ tāsāṃ dharme ca paśuṃ prokṣaṇe
mokṣaśca nihitaṃ yajñe bhairavokteṣu sarvadā
anena vidhinā vatsa hiṃsanti paśavo yadi
p. 39a) siddhyate mahatāṃ siddhiraṣṭasiddhisamanvitā
kasyedaṃ viditaṃ jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ vijñāna sammitam
paśūnāṃ caiva sarveṣāmādikartā prajāpatiḥ
vedayajñeṣu paśavo hiṃsanti brāhmaṇottamāḥ
sūkṣmapuryaṣṭakaṃ yacca bhūtānāṃ hṛdi saṃsthitam
prāṇāpānodaye tasmin bindunāda layaṃ gatāḥ
gatireṣā hi caiteṣāṃ tadātmetaṃ labhanti hi
prāṇāpānapravāhena na viditvā pibanti hi
* * * * * * * * * * bhakṣyāni kāni tu
bhairavoktena vidhinā samyag yoga balena tu
sa siddhaḥ sādhakaḥ sohi śeṣā vai madhyamāḥ smṛtāḥ
kṣīraṃ tu kurute madhyaṃ saṃśaye samupasthite
prāṇāpānāntara caronāḍi tritaya yāyinaḥ
p. 40a) sauraṃmārgaṃ parityajya cāndraṃ mārgaṃ tathaiva ca
yena vijñāta mātreṇa bhrānti jñānaṃ nivartate
yat tvayā coditaṃ praśnaṃ nissandigdhaṃ vadāmyaham
saṃsthitā sarvabhūteṣu jagadurddhraṃ? yayākhilam
grasate sṛjate śaktiśśivājñā jñāpitā guha
vayaṃ pitāmahaṃ viṣṇuṃ na bīndvanalameva ca
bhūyo bhūyo hi jāyante bhūyo bhūyo mriyanti ca
śaktirna lupyate sā vai paramādvaita vartinī
yayāvyāptamidaṃ viśvaṃ bhūtasargaṃ carācaram
ekaikaṃ maṇimāśritya yathāviddhyanti vedhakāḥ
sūtraṃ tāsāṃ śivaṃ sākṣāt tena te grathitā guha
mahābhūtāni sarvāṇi sarve cicchakti sambhavāḥ
na hi jānanti tāṃ mūḍhā mahāmāyā vimohitāḥ
sthitā sā agni rūpeṇa sarvatra vāyunāśritā
brahmaveśma bhaved dehaṃ jñānaṃ tatraiva dīpakam
taṃ dṛṣṭyā te gamiṣyanti ajanma padamavyayam
saṃsthitā sarvabhūtānāṃ brahmādīnāṃ śikhidhvaja
vayaṃ brahmādibhissārdhaṃ naiva muktāḥ śikhidhvaja
anyepi yoginaḥ sarve makṣamārgānu kāṅkṣiṇaḥ
kāraṇaṃ tatra vai hyekaṃ yukti bhedaḥ pṛthak pṛthak
rājasaṃ svargakāmānāṃ nārakaṃ tamasā vṛtam
rājasaṃ mānuṣairvatsa svargā vāpti phalapradam
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena sātvikaṃ yāgamārabhet
p. 42a) sātvikaṃ mānasaṃ yāgaṃ tatra hiṃsā na vidyate
mānase naiva yāgena ye yajanti sadāśivam
dravyaśuddhistu paramaṃ sambhāraṃ yeṣu krīyate
tadā taṃ dravya sambhāraṃ śuddho bhavati ṣaṇmukha
yaṣṭaṃ hi nirmalaṃ tena pratyutatṛṇavadbhavet
tadarthaṃ na vimuktāste ye yajanti sadā dhanaiḥ
p. 42b) tad deyaṃ devagurave vipre vā brahmavādine
akṣayyaṃ bhavate vatsa kalpakoṭi śatairapi
saṃbhārā ye bahirkecit sarve cicchakti sambhavāḥ
sa jīvāni tu te sarve śivaṃ teṣāṃ hṛdi sthitam
sa jīvāḥ paśavo jñeyāstarujātīnisarvaśaḥ
ye sthitāḥ phalasandho *? vaśyākarṣaṇamāraṇaiḥ
p. 43a) caturdaśavidhaṃ vatsa bhūtasargaṃ carācaram
adhunā śrotumicchāmi iṣṭamiṣṭoturottaram
tadā sa tuṣṭo bhagavāñśivopyaśivahāparaḥ
ahiṃsā sarvabhūteṣu careṣu hyacareṣu ca
hiṃsākṣaraṃ vijānīyāt tasmāt taṃ parivarjayet
ye yajanti hitaṃ vatsa te muktā bhavabandhanāt
ajñānādupadeśasya śivajñāna bahiṣkṛtaḥ
niṣprapañcaṃ paraṃ tatvamaparaṃ tu parāparam
tasya yāgaṃ ca kurvīta niṣprapañcaṃ hi mānusam
manasai tāni kartavyaṃ vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā
tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi yathārthaṃ tadbravīhi me
sarve tiṣṭhanti tatraiva mānase tvakhilā guha
tatrasthaṃ saṅgamaṃ vatsa śivaṃ nādātmakaṃ śubham
pravāhaṃ tasya tīrthasya suṣumṇāḍyāntare sthitam
na cātra vighnā hiṃsanti duṣṭā ye vai carācare
nā cātra hiṃsā dṛśyeta na tu pītvā karaṃ tathā
tepi tiṣṭanti cāteva ātmaśuddhyartha kāraṇam
śivatīrthena tiṣṭhanti mānase aśivāpahe
uttaptāste sadā vighnairdivyabhaumāntarikṣagaiḥ
anorthādbāhyatīrthāni varjitāni sadā guha
yasmād bādhā bhavet teṣāṃ tasmāt tāstu vivarjayet
amṛtaṃ sravate nityaṃ piṅgalābhyantare sthitam
svarṇopalabdhi vimalaṃ sā nandaṃ nandaśītalam
tasmin snānaṃ sadā kuryād vidhi dṛṣṭena karmaṇā
yat kiñciditi kartavyaṃ tat sarvaṃ mānasaṃ kuru
sarve tiṣṭhanti cātraiva ahiṃsā tu samarpitāḥ
etaddhi paramaṃ tīrthamayaṃ hi paramo japaḥ
bāhyatīrthāni tuṣṭāni mantrān bāhyāṃstu sarvaśaḥ
tīrtheṣu ye sthitāḥ keciddīnādyāḥ prāṇino guha
śivatīrthaparijñānātsamyagyoga balena tu
na cātra hiṃsate kaścin na tilāndarbha eva ca
smaraṇā cchivatīrthasya na kiñcidapi lupyate
bhūyo vijñātumicchāmi dhyānaṃ deheśvarātmakam
pratyakṣaṃ ca parokṣaṃ ca adhunā darśayāmite
taiḥ prāpyamakhilaṃ vatsa mokṣamārgaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
taiḥ śuddhāḥ sarvadā vatsa yatra yatrāśrame sthitāḥ
p. 46b) sa tu mantraṃ śivaṃ śāstraṃ kṣetraṃ hi paramaṃ tu saḥ
darśanādeva vai tasya naśyante ca diśo daśa
karaṇena tu saṃpaśyet samyag yoga balena tu
etad yathārthaṃ yuñjīta tato dhyānaṃ samārabhet
taṃ vicāraya yatnena nāḍicakrodare sthitam
ekaika bhramataiṣā vai prāṇāpānāntara sthitā
p. 47a) prāṇaṃ teṣāṃ bhavet prāṇaṃ praṇamya tu paraṃ viduḥ
piṅgalā tu bhavennābhistasya cakrasya ṣaṇmukha
taṃ jñātvā paśyate vatsa śivaṃ parama kāraṇam
tadā gamya sthitaṃ devaṃ piṅgalābhyantare sthitam
tasya madhye sthitaṃ devaṃ yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati
kadambagolakākāraṃ sūryakoṭi samaprabham
p. 47b) anumānaṃ na vai tasya hetunā naiva dṛśyate
tatastvā yatanaṃ gacchenmānusaṃ mānasena tu
adhunā śrotumicchāmi hṛdguhyeśvara pūjanam
idaṃ guhyaṃ tvayaivādya yanna kasyāpi bhāṣitam
*? yajanti sa jīvaistu jīvaiścicchakti sambhavaiḥ
p. 48a) sa cetanāni bhūtāni yasmāt tāneva mohayet
śivātmā dṛṣṭa rūpeṇa sarvatraiva vyavasthitaḥ
bhuñjate tu parāśaktiḥ paraṃ cātra alepakam
evaṃ jñātvā ahiṃsāṃ vai sarvabhūteṣu kārayet
hiṃsā yuktena yogena sambhāra bahulena ca
amānāmnā tu yogena hiṃsā bhavati sarvadā
p. 48b) evaṃ jñātvā yajet sarvaṃ mānusaṃ yāgamuttamam
samaṃ paśyati sarveṣāmahiṃsā procyate tu sā
samuktaḥ prakṛterbandhācchive tiṣṭhati śāśvate
antaḥ karṇādikaṃ vatsa yanmayoktaṃ hi darśane
antaḥkaraṇa vinyāsaṃ bhūtaśuddhyartha kāraṇam
kṛtvāntaḥ karaṇaṃ vatsa bhūtaśuddhiṃ tathaiva ca
p. 49a) ātmajñaṃ tu punarvatsa nityaśuddhaṃ sadā bhavet
nitya śuddhi hitaṃ bhūtvā na kiñcit sādhayatyasau
yasya śaktirbhavatyugrā yaḥ śodhayati vai param
atorthāt ketanaṃ vatsa ātmajñe niṣprayojanam
sa eva paramaṃ dāma tatra śuddhyati te khilaṃ
yathoktena vidhānena samyg yoga balena tu
p. 49b) yajante devatāssarve brahmādyāśca maharṣayaḥ
yogārthaṃ dravya sambhāraṃ taṃ hi cātraiva tiṣṭhati
taṃ labhiṣyasi sarvaṃ vai mānase taṃ śikhidhvaja
ubhau tāvekadā vatsa yajatvaṃ yat tu rocate
manasā citsvabhāvena sākārā kriyate kriyā
tasmāt tvaṃ sarvadā vatsa nityaṃ śakti sthitaṃ yajet
citsaṃjñā citsamudbhutā bhutābhuteṣu saṃsthitā
saṃsthitāścivatattve rasadasarvagato vibhuḥ
taṃ hi pūjaya yatvena vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā
tasmāttaṃ pūjayedvatsa ahiṃsā kusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ
dānāni yāni coktāni śivadharmekhilāni tu
sarvakāmāni vai tadvatmānasaṃ yāga muttamam
iḍādayo yajed yastu rājasaṃ yāgamucyate
suṣumṇe tvāṃ parityajya piṅgalā nāḍisthaṃ yajet
tasmin madhye sthitaṃ devaṃ taṃ nedaṃ pūjayet tu saḥ
turyodbhavati? sarvāṇi turyasthāne gatāni tu
turyasthāne layaṃ kṛtvā hṛdhisthaṃ pūjayet sadā
hṛdisthaṃ turyasaṃsthaṃ tu ubhau yo vetti tatvataḥ
prāṇāpānāntarasthena śivena śikhivāhana
prāṇāpānau tu sandigdhau rajastamasamanvitau
sātvikaṃ saṅgamaṃ teṣāṃ tena kuryācchivārcanam
brahmādi stambha paryantaṃ trailokyaṃ sa carācaram
p. 51b) mānase naiva yāgena muktohaṃ sarvadā vibho
tathāpi jñātu micchāmi japyaṃ vai sarvadā param
rahasyaṃ caiva guhyaṃ ca japyaṃ japyottamottamam
na punarmānasaṃ japyaṃ mokṣamārgaphalapradam
tadāhaṃ kathayiṣyāmi rahasyaṃ kṛttikā suta
sa tu saṅkhyā yate japyaṃ japaṃ tu kurute tu saḥ
p. 52a) pratyahaṃ pratyahaṃ vatsa japasaṅkhyaṃ karoti saḥ
sūrya cicchaktirityāhustasmiṃste kathitā guha
ye sthitā phalasandhāne vaśyākarṣaṇamāraṇe
punarātma vide vatsa mantra tantraiḥ prayojanam
taṃ viditvā mahāsena mantratantrāṃstyajedguha
tatohaṃ kathayiṣyāmi yathā bhavati tacchṛṇu
śivajapyaṃ bhavedeṣa śivaṃ hyaśiva kāriṇam
ubhau cākarṣayedyastu sa japaṃ kurute guha
evāṃ gamāgamaṃ jñeyaṃ taṃ japaṃ brahmaśāśvatam
agnikāryaṃ ca metātatatvamācakṣva vai prabho
bhūyopi kathayiṣyāmi agnikāryaṃ tu mānasam
hṛdisthaṃ paramaṃ tejo na tu jānanti mohitāḥ
jvalanasya tu tat tejaḥ pūrṇamindustathaiva ca
bāhyegnīnāṃ hutaṃ havyaṃ hiṃsanti guhyakādayaḥ
tadā te lupyate vatsa bāhyāgniṣu hutaṃ haviḥ
yadātra hūyate yasmāt tasmāt taṃ hiṃsapūrvakam
śivāgnirvaibhavatyeṣa śivamaśivahāriṇam
na hi kuṇḍaṃ nu vaḥ kāryaṃ mekhalairvātha yoninā
kuṇḍatrayaṃ sthitaṃ dehe agni tritayameva ca
mukhakuṇḍe sthitaṃ vatsa nāmnācāhavaniyakam
teṣāṃ homaṃ prakurvīta vidhi dṛṣṭena karmaṇā
dakṣiṇāgniṃ tato juhyānnābhikuṇḍe sthite guha
tadācāhavanīyognirmukhakuṇḍe sthito guha
tasmin pūrṇāhutiṃ dadyādviṣuvatkaraṇena tu
tasmin kāle yajed yastu tatsarvaṃ cākṣayaṃ bhavet
prāṇādyā vāyavaḥ pañca homayet tu yathā kramam
amṛtaṃ bhavate vatsa amṛtaṃ taṃtu tiṣṭhati
prāṇāpānāntarasthaṃ tu yairjñātaṃ śikhivāahana
turyodbhavāmṛtājyena nityamagniṃ prapūjayet
